name: Feynman
description: Unofficial Unraid Docker packaging for Feynman, the open-source AI research agent by Advait Paliwal. Includes the browser-based Science Workbench for research projects, literature workflows, artifacts, notebooks and model-provider integrations.

paths.name: Feynman Config
paths.description: Persistent Feynman settings, sessions, credentials and Workbench state.

paths.name: Workspace
paths.description: Research workspace containing outputs, papers, notes and project files.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: HTTP port for the Feynman Science Workbench.

variables.name: Workbench Port
variables.description: Internal Workbench listen port. Normally keep this at 8787.

variables.name: Disable Workbench Auth
variables.description: true = convenient trusted-LAN access. false = Feynman generates a token URL on each container start; retrieve it from the container log.
